questions.q_en: There are two numbers X and Y such that geometric mean of X and Y is four-fifth of the Arithmetic mean of X and Y. What is the ratio of X and Y?
questions.solution_en:
The geometric mean of X and Y is four-fifth of the Arithmetic mean of X and Y

=> √XY = (4/5) * (X + Y)/2

=> (X + Y)/2√XY = 5/4

By componendo and dividendo rule,

(X + Y + 2√XY)/(X + Y - 2√XY) = (5+4)/(5-4)

=> (√X + √Y)2/(√X - √Y)2 = 9/1

=> (√X + √Y)/(√X - √Y) = 3

=> √X + √Y = 3√X - 3√Y

=> 2√X = 4√Y

=> √X/√Y = 2

=> X/Y = 4/1
questions.solution_hi:

questions.q_en:
If an even number is added to the average of five consecutive odd numbers, we get Z and if an odd number is added to the average of five consecutive odd numbers, we get A. Which of the following will be the possible value of product of Z and A?

1) 25

2) 42

3) 45
questions.solution_en:
Average of five consecutive odd number will also be an odd number.

We know that,

Odd + odd = Even so, A will be an even number

Odd + even = Odd so, Z will be an odd number

Now,

We know that product of an even number and odd number is always an even number.

So, Z * A = even number.

Therefore, Possible value of Z * A will be 42.

questions.q_en: Two trains - A and B are 960 km apart. If they start at the same time towards each other, they will meet after 4 hours. If they move in the same direction, train A will meet train B after 24 hours. Find the speed of train B.
questions.solution_en:
Let, speed of train A = X kmph and speed of train B = Y kmph

Relative speed when both trains travel towards each other = (X + Y) kmph

Relative speed when both trains travel in the same direction = (X - Y) kmph [A is faster train]

According to question,

960/(X + Y) = 4

X + Y = 240 ... (1)

960/(X - Y) = 24

X - Y = 40 ... (2)

From equation (1) and (2),

2X = 280 ⇒ X = 140

Y = 100

Speed of train B = 100 kmph

questions.q_en: A rhombus ABCD has the diagonals of length 16cm and 12 cm. What is the distance between its parallel lines?
questions.solution_en:
Since the diagonals of rhombus perpendicularly bisects each other

Side of rhombus = ((12/2)2 + (16/2)2)1/2 = (36 + 64)1/2 = 10 cm

Area of the rhombus = ½ * product of diagonals = ½ * 16*12 = 96cm2

Area of rhombus = Side * distance between parallel lines

96cm2 = 10*distance between parallel lines

Distance between parallel lines = 96/10 = 9.6cm

questions.q_en: In a circular race of 4800m, A and B start from the same point and at the same time with speeds of 36 km/h and 54 km/h. When will they meet again for the first time on the track if they are running in the opposite direction?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of A = 36 X (1000/3600) = 10 m/s

Speed of B = 54 X (1000/3600) = 15 m/s

Relative speed (since they are running in opposite directions) = Speed of A + Speed of B

=> 10 + 15 = 25 m/s

Time when A and B will meet again = Length of the track / Relative speed

=> 4800 / 25 = 192 seconds

questions.q_en: A boat goes 63 km upstream and returns in 4 hours. The ratio of speeds of the boat and the stream is 8:1. How much distance can the boat cover in 5 hours 15 minutes when running in still water?
questions.solution_en:
Let the speed of the stream be S km/h. then the speed of boat = 8S

Upstream speed = 7S and downstream speed = 9S

63/7S + 63/9S = 4

=> 9/S + 7/S = 4

=> S = 4

Hence speed of boat = 32 km/h

Required distance = 32 x 5.25 = 168km

questions.q_en: If n(A B) = 43, n(A) = 27, and n(B) = 31, then find the number of elements that belongs to only A.
questions.solution_en:
We know that,

n(A B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B)

43 = 27 + 31 - n(A ∩ B)

n(A ∩ B) = 58 - 43 = 15

Number of elements that belongs to only A = n(A) - n(A ∩ B) = 27 - 15 = 12
